answer_1.quote: The task of Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) automatically detects and corrects grammatical errors in a given text.
answer_1.outputs: corrected text with grammatical errors fixed

answer_2.quote: We introduce CLEME2.0, an interpretable reference-based metric describing four fundamental aspects of GEC systems...

answer_3.quote: We prompt Llama-2-7B to assign edit weights from 1 to 5, where a higher value signifies more critical edits.

answer_4.quote: In this assessment, 8 native speakers are asked to rank the systems' outputs from best to worst.
answer_4.guideline: rank the systems' outputs from best to worst based on pairwise judgments
